verses.text: A Psalm of David. I will lift You high, my God, the King, and I will bless Your name forever and ever!

segments.text: A Psalm of David. I will lift You high, my God, the King, and I will bless Your name forever and ever!

verses.text: With every day, I will bless You, and I will praise Your name, forever and ever!

segments.text: With every day, I will bless You, and I will praise Your name, forever and ever!

verses.text: Great [is] YHWH and to be praised greatly, and of His greatness there is no searching out.

segments.text: Great [is] YHWH and to be praised greatly, and of His greatness there is no searching out.

verses.text: Generation to generation will commend Your works, and Your mighty acts they will declare.

segments.text: Generation to generation will commend Your works, and Your mighty acts they will declare.

verses.text: The splendor of the glory of Your majesty, and words of Your wonders I will put forth.

segments.text: The splendor of the glory of Your majesty, and words of Your wonders I will put forth.

verses.text: And the strength of Your fearful acts they will speak, and Your greatness I will recount.

segments.text: And the strength of Your fearful acts they will speak, and Your greatness I will recount.

verses.text: The memory of the abundance of Your goodness they will pour forth, and Your righteousness they will sing out.

segments.text: The memory of the abundance of Your goodness they will pour forth, and Your righteousness they will sing out.

verses.text: Gracious and compassionate [is] YHWH, slow to anger and great in loving devotion.

segments.text: Gracious and compassionate [is] YHWH, slow to anger and great in loving devotion.

verses.text: Good [is] YHWH to all, and His mercies [are] upon all His works.

segments.text: Good [is] YHWH to all, and His mercies [are] upon all His works.

verses.text: O YHWH, all Your works will give You thanks, and Your holy ones will bless You.

segments.text: O YHWH, all Your works will give You thanks, and Your holy ones will bless You.

verses.text: The glory of Your kingdom they will speak, and Your might they will declare,

segments.text: The glory of Your kingdom they will speak, and Your might they will declare,

verses.text: to make known to the sons of man His mighty [deeds], and the glory of the majesty of His kingdom.

segments.text: to make known to the sons of man His mighty [deeds], and the glory of the majesty of His kingdom.

verses.text: Your kingdom [is] a kingdom of all ages, and Your dominion [is] in every generation and generation. YHWH is faithful in all His words and kind in all His actions.

segments.text: Your kingdom [is] a kingdom of all ages, and Your dominion [is] in every generation and generation. YHWH is faithful in all His words and kind in all His actions.

verses.text: YHWH is upholding all those falling, and raising up all those bent down low.

segments.text: YHWH is upholding all those falling, and raising up all those bent down low.

verses.text: The eyes of all wait for You, and You give to them their food in its time.

segments.text: The eyes of all wait for You, and You give to them their food in its time.

verses.text: You open Your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

segments.text: You open Your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

verses.text: Righteous [is] YHWH in all His ways, and kind in all His works.

segments.text: Righteous [is] YHWH in all His ways, and kind in all His works.

verses.text: Near [is] YHWH to all those calling on Him, to all who call on Him in truth.

segments.text: Near [is] YHWH to all those calling on Him, to all who call on Him in truth.

verses.text: He does the desire of those who fear Him, and their cry for help He hears, and He saves them.

segments.text: He does the desire of those who fear Him, and their cry for help He hears, and He saves them.

verses.text: YHWH is guarding all those loving Him, and all the wicked He will destroy.

segments.text: YHWH is guarding all those loving Him, and all the wicked He will destroy.

verses.text: My mouth will declare the praise of YHWH, and all flesh blesses the name of His holiness, forever and ever!

segments.text: My mouth will declare the praise of YHWH, and all flesh blesses the name of His holiness, forever and ever!
